original_text: Create an executive Power BI sales-performance report. I need total sales, total orders, average order value and year-over-year sales. Show performance over time and let users filter by region, business area and product category. Include an executive summary and a detailed regional view. Use our corporate reporting standards.

clarifications.topic: Does Sales mean net SalesAmount or gross pre-discount value?
clarifications.golden_answer: Net sales in AUD, SUM(FactSales.SalesAmount); DiscountAmount is a line-level discount already deducted.

clarifications.topic: What prior-year coverage and comparison period should YoY use?
clarifications.golden_answer: Use full calendar 2025 against 2024; both complete synthetic years are supplied. Outside coverage or with zero prior-year sales, return blank rather than inventing growth.

clarifications.topic: Is Region only a slicer or an access-security requirement?
clarifications.golden_answer: Region is a slicer only in this golden case; no regional RLS is requested. A slicer is not security.
